vulnerabilities.description: A crafted pattern can make "reef-regex" use excessive memory when compiled.
vulnerabilities.detail:
Patterns with many nested repetitions, such as (a{1,1000}){1,1000}, expand to a
program whose size grows with the product of the bounds.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Upgrade to 1.11.2 or later, or set a compile-size limit.

analysis.detail: Patterns come from the admin API only.
